test_title: PYST 7: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: All hands are legs.

Some legs are faces.

Conclusions: (I) All legs are hands.

(II) All faces are legs.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e1b222c1ad60beffbd01911efdd9a85690bff536c9770befd1c119316b15e14.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All legs are hands → **Does not follow **( All hands are legs means some legs are hands but all legs are hands is possible but not definite).

(II) All faces are leg → **Does not follow** ( Some legs are faces. so, some faces are legs but all faces are legs is not true)

 Neither conclusion I nor II follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
